JavaScript Date is only millisecond-precise: it may format a display, but retain the original six-place string for identity, exact comparison and fingerprinting.

anyOf.description: Authorized resulting/current record metadata, not a domain record payload. row_version changes with relevant progress/concurrent writes; material_version pins immutable approved/evidence-bound content. Partial progress can move row 7 to 8 while material remains 3. A material edit increments both and invalidates affected approval with history. Domain schemas enumerate independent approval/fulfillment/payment/exception axes in states; a generic status must not replace them. Returned current state never silently rebases a draft or expected version.

items.description: Correctable field feedback. path is an RFC 6901 pointer relative to the endpoint request JSON body (not CommandContext or a translated label). Empty pointer targets the body as a whole. Do not echo sensitive submitted data.

anyOf.description: Stable machine reason and scoped human explanation of why the action cannot proceed. Separate from field feedback and from a server-permitted next action. Domain-specific reason codes extend this shape; never disclose another chapter or unauthorized record.

items.description: Server-permitted next step and readable label; not an authorization token. Recheck current authority when used. No transport outcome authorizes repeating a physical handover; reconciliation is separate from database retry.

data.description: Optional extension slot only. Endpoint owners MUST constrain/require it with their domain payload schema; this shared slice defines no domain properties. Forbidden and uncertain responses carry no data. Do not use this slot to bypass the owning source operation.

allOf.description: Shared v1 result envelope, no identity/evidence/business payload. Human-readable messages/labels accompany stable codes (UX-01/UX-04); color alone is insufficient. Correctable/stale/forbidden/uncertain results preserve the local draft and original attempt separately; no error response replaces the draft. A transport failure or malformed response is handled locally as uncertain even when no server envelope exists. Null record or operation means unavailable/unauthorized metadata, not a claim that no business effect exists.

anyOf.description: Stable machine reason and scoped human explanation of why the action cannot proceed. Separate from field feedback and from a server-permitted next action. Domain-specific reason codes extend this shape; never disclose another chapter or unauthorized record.

items.description: Server-permitted next step and readable label; not an authorization token. Recheck current authority when used. No transport outcome authorizes repeating a physical handover; reconciliation is separate from database retry.

data.description: Optional extension slot only. Endpoint owners MUST constrain/require it with their domain payload schema; this shared slice defines no domain properties. Forbidden and uncertain responses carry no data. Do not use this slot to bypass the owning source operation.

starts_at.description: UTC DATETIME(6) wire instant, six fractional digits and Z. Enable date-time format assertion in validators. JavaScript Date is only millisecond-precise: it may format a display, but retain the original six-place string for identity, exact comparison and fingerprinting.

chapter_id.description: Positive BIGINT UNSIGNED ID as exact base-10 text, range 1?18446744073709551615, without leading zeros. Never convert to JavaScript Number or PHP float. Pattern enforces the storage range; the server also enforces scoped reference existence and authorization. Human document references and public operation IDs are distinct types.
